neighbours.label: The causal link word ('caused by', 'occur in', 'result from') right after a subject that counts deaths, injuries or illness, vs the same link words after a neutral administrative subject
fire: Health officials said that most drowning deaths are caused by a lack of supervision near pools.
According to the survey, the majority of serious injuries occur in the first week on the job.
Researchers believe that many cases of the disease result from exposure to dust in mines.
In the region, nearly a third of child deaths are caused by diarrhoea from dirty water.
Data from the clinic show that most poisonings occur in homes with unlocked cupboards.
Experts note that most burns in toddlers result from spilled hot drinks in the kitchen.
Last year, the bulk of hospital admissions for asthma were caused by smoke from wildfires.
Statistics suggest that most fatal falls among builders occur on scaffolding without rails.
quiet: Office managers said that most delivery delays are caused by a lack of loading bays.
According to the survey, the majority of staff meetings occur in the first week of the month.
Researchers believe that many of the library loans result from posters in the lobby.
In the region, nearly a third of the parcels are sent by courier from the depot.
Data from the shop show that most purchases occur on Saturdays before lunch.
Teachers note that most questions in class come from the students in the front row.
Last year, the bulk of the new signups for the gym were driven by a spring discount.
Statistics suggest that most bus trips in the city occur on routes near the river.
